text: Hi, I called twenty minutes ago about a burst pipe in my basement and nobody's called me back yet! Water is still coming in.
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you shut off the main water valve to stop the flow of water?
I tried, but the valve is stuck and won't turn. Water's still pouring in.
Okay, please stay safe and keep clear of any electrical outlets near the water. What is your full address so I can page our on-call technician right away?
Thank you. What is the best callback phone number for you?
